title: Azure DevOps
description:
[Azure DevOps](https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/services/devops/) provides version control, reporting, requirements management, project management, automated builds, testing and release management capabilities. It covers the entire application lifecycle and enables DevOps capabilities.

## How to connect to Azure DevOps on Workato

1. [OAuth](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/devops/integrate/get-started/authentication/oauth?view=azure-devops) 
2. [Personal Access Token](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/devops/organizations/accounts/use-personal-access-tokens-to-authenticate?view=azure-devops&tabs=Windows#create-a-pat)
3. [Service Principal](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/devops/integrate/get-started/authentication/service-principal-managed-identity?view=azure-devops)

## Examples of what you can do with this connector

- Get insights into tasks and work items.
- Automate tasks and collaborate with the team.

## Objects this connector supports

- Project
- Board
- Board columns
- Build
- Build log
- Run
- Work item

## Support

Let our support team know the name of this connector and that it was installed from the community so they can route your support tickets properly.
